_comentario: Texturas do chão (GDD, seção 17, 'Piso e chão'). [TIPO] no estilo é trocado pelo campo 'tipo' de cada textura; as cores vêm da paleta da seção 17. chao = chão natural (só textura); piso = piso construído (textura + placa 1x1 m no Blender). emissao: gera máscara de emissão pelas cores das runas. nivelar: false mantém manchas grandes (o círculo de runas é o motivo principal). tentativa_escolhida: a imagem usada, escolhida vendo as duas em 2x2 (ver DIARIO, 26/09/2026). modo placa: laje com borda própria, sem mistura para repetir (a borda é desenho; misturar picota as runas).
estilo: seamless tileable top-down hand-painted texture, [TIPO], stylized dark whimsical medieval, flat lighting, no shadows, no perspective, no objects, muted earthy palette

texturas.tipo: dark mossy grass ground in deep moss green (#5E6E45 to #7A8B5A) with subtle swirls and small spiral patterns woven into the grass blades
packed bare earth soil in wood brown (#6B5B4B) with fine cracks and faint lighter patches
flat natural rocky ground in stone grey (#A89F91) with irregular cracks and darker crevices
dark wet mud ground in deep brown with a faint blue-green sheen (#4F7C7A) and shallow smeared streaks
fine river sand in wheat color (#C9B38A) with gentle wave ripples
wooden plank floor with slightly crooked boards running horizontally in wood brown (#6B5B4B), visible grain and small nail heads
cobblestone pavement of rounded irregular stones in stone grey (#A89F91) with dark mortar gaps
dark slate stone floor slab in deep purple grey (#2B2140 to #4A4458) engraved with a single circle of glowing sickly green (#9BC53D) runes in the center, the rest of the slab plain carved stone
